text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I would like to hear your thoughts.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Scarlet is acting strange.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Even when passing by each other in the hallway this morning—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Good morning,
Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Huh!? U-Ummm...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah. ...Good morning, Chan.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Even when I saw her in the cafeteria at night—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Scarlet, would you like to eat lunch together?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Huh?!
...Er, yeah, of course...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
She seemed a bit off.
Did I do something wrong?
I don't know the reason, but... if you're curious, in a case like this, the quickest way is—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry!
I didn't mean to make you feel bad!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Um... Looking at the Twinkle Series race records,
I realized something. I—"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"To think that in the mile races where I was supposed to have decent confidence,
Chan-chan just kept beating me over and over...!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Mmh, I see...?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "I didn't just feel frustrated about losing the race like I usually do!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I started getting all... aggressive, in a way unfitting for a top honor student, and felt like I was going to say something terribly blunt...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "So, until that settled down, I kept my distance for a bit."

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Is having no hesitation a bad thing?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: It might not necessarily be a bad thing, though.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Still, to me, Chan-chan is someone I just want to be kind to.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
"...I see.
Still, Chan-meâ"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: "‘Your win was just a fluke! Next time, I'm gonna beat you to a pulp!’"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I feel you could have at least told me something like this.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I think that way, how do I put it...
would make me happier.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: ...That would make me happier...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu. Is that so?
I'm sorry, I didn't realize.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I can't just change my tone out of nowhere, but... still,
I'm done hiding my feelings. That's why—

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"I am definitely taking the win in the next mile race.
Brace yourself, Machan!"

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Just what I wanted.

Aston Machan seemed to have
become just a little closer
with Daiwa Scarlet.
